steps.text: Whisk sugar, vinegar, oil, garlic, rosemary, and black pepper together in a large bowl until sugar dissolves. Reserve 1 tablespoon marinade in a small bowl; set aside. Add salmon to large bowl with marinade; toss until evenly coated with marinade. Cover the bowl with plastic wrap; marinate in the refrigerator for 30 minutes.
Preheat the oven to 450 degrees F (230 degrees C). Line a baking dish with aluminum foil.
Remove salmon from marinade and shake off excess; discard remaining marinade. Place salmon in the prepared baking dish; season with salt.
Roast in the preheated oven until salmon flakes easily with a fork, about 10 minutes. Brush salmon with reserved 1 tablespoon marinade; return to the oven. Roast until salmon glazed, about 1 minute.

raw_recipe.headline: Roast Salmon With Balsamic Vinegar
raw_recipe.description: This roast salmon with balsamic vinegar recipe uses just a few simple ingredients. Caramelizing the marinade gives the salmon its crave-worthy glaze.

review.reviewBody: This is a very good marinade. I wound up marinating for more than 30 minutes. I did use fresh Rosemary. I prefer to use fresh herbs because it elevates the dish to a whole new level. I would use this marinade on other fish. I would even suggest using this for a pork loin or pork chops. I think the flavors would go really well with that type of protein. I served this on a bed of parmesan polenta and topped it with a polenta cake. I reserved some of the marinade to drizzle over the fish. The marinade I reserved was put aside before I added the fish. As to not contaminate it. I highly recommend reserving some on the side. It's really delicious. I did DOUBLE the recipe knowing I was going to reserve some to drizzle. Thanks for sharing.

Easy recipe but read reviews prior - so substituted fresh rosemary instead of dried. Also used fresh garlic clove. Added 1/2 teaspoon red flaked chili peppers. Substituted honey instead of brown sugar. Cut salt in half. Used entire marinade in baking process - just kept it covered for approx 10 minutes then low broil uncovered for approx 4 minutes
Result - baked right through, nice color, good taste. Flavor not overbearing - so either would pair with flavorful sides or increase the spices in the marinade. Would try this recipe again!

I used half of a whole salmon as that was all I had. I knew the marinade wasn't going to penetrate the fish very well, so I diced up some Roma tomatoes and roasted them with the salmon. The tomatoes took in the marinade nicely, creating a balsalmic/tomato salsa. Yum!

Easy to make with a nice flavor. I made it with herb baked baby red skin potatoes and a salad that I had already planned on making with a balsamic vinegarette which is what I used for the salmon because I didn't have regular balsamic vinegar. While family loved it. I baked it on a bed of red onions and I put it under the broiler for one additional minute. Well done.
Husband was very happy! I reduced sugar by half and accidently added the salt to the marinade but it was great just like that.
I used parsley flakes instead of rosemary. Super tasty and good.
Needed a quick recipe so I didn't marinate at all. Used fresh rosemary and extra garlic. Delicious--all three kids and husband cleaned their plates and all but one went back for seconds. Thank you!

This was really good. Salmon is probably my least favorite fish but I've been trying new ways of incorporating it more into my diet. This was probably the best way I've made it so far. I actually marinated all night and it had such good flavor. I would definitely make this again.
really good, didn't have any rosemary so substituted dill and cut back the olive oil by 1/4 tsp and added sesame oil...slammin good...will be making this again
This was the best salmon have ever made,I used espresso vinegar very good flavor

Wonderful and flavorful. It's the dead of winter and instead of the grill, I used my oven. Turned out perfect. Like a few others, I reserved some of the marinade and topped it with it at serving time. Very, very good and most definitely will make this again.
Cook time wasn’t nearly long enough. Salmon came out half cooked and mostly raw. Had to finish it on the stove top.
This was fantastic! Making it again!!
Ok, so I did add to the spices because like spice! I added garlic, onion powder, garlic powder, cayenne and red pepper flakes. I also squeezed the juice of an orange into it.
Will make again, maybe swap out maple syrup for the brown sugar next time!
pretty easy to make and came out delicious. Make a bit more of the marinade for a dipping sauce.
very good, the marinade was mild and not overpowering, I would make it again

It was pretty good, but I think I'll keep on looking for a better recipe.
